status: band rule, amendment 1, the floors: computed before any number of the built task exists; committed by the maintainers after an independent recomputation. The committed rules/band_rule.json and rules/BAND_RULE.txt are not edited; where they differ on a floor of e_z, theta, e_xy or d_m, this file holds.
no_built_numbers: No number of any built unit, shift, tray or submission appears in this file. Every value is a printed tolerance carried to the scored point through the maker's nominal model.
authority: rules/band_rule.json, full_end.floor_rule: 'a floor is what a printed tolerance or a field's resolution produces at the scored point, with one line of derivation'
rule: floor_x = max(the committed floor of x, T_x); the full end F_x = max(floor_x, 1.25 x the 90th percentile of x over the privileged reference's rows) as committed
full_end: The full end stays as committed: F_x = max(floor_x, 1.25 x the 90th percentile of x over the privileged reference's rows on the three true units, pooled).
T_x: the 90th percentile (nearest rank: the value of rank ceil(0.9 n)) of |x| at the tray's reference point, pooled over every (draw, target) or (draw, move) pair, on the nominal model, for targets commanded as displacements from the module angles read at the end of the seating with F taken at its drawn pose, when the tolerances that reach x and that no frame shows are drawn uniformly inside their printed ranges in one draw

tolerances.range: +-0.3 mm per axis, +-0.05 deg about each axis (F's frame: origin on the bench top under F's reference point)
+-0.5 mm per horizontal axis of F (nothing prints a centring of a presented tray)

tolerances.tolerance: the mounting of the right arm against the left
tolerances.range: +-0.5 mm per axis, +-0.15 deg about each axis
along the closing axis +-1.0 mm, the two tilts +-0.5 deg; along the pad faces and about the closing axis the pads hold where they closed (anywhere inside the capture box, +-8 mm, +-4 deg)
tolerances.why: contributes nothing on this route (fit_note below)

route.reading: a controller reads every arm module's angle at the end of the seating (the read angle = the joint angle less the zero residual), takes the hand's pose to be the nominal model's forward kinematics of those angles and the tray to be at F's drawn seated pose (0.220, 0, 0.280); a target t is commanded as the pure translation t - (0.220, 0, 0.280) of that believed hand pose through the nominal inverse kinematics at the target's elbow swivel; the joint reaches the commanded angle plus the residual (a static offset: no load, friction or dynamics); the true hand is the nominal model with the true mounting
route.first_order: F's survey: t_F + a_F x (0, 0, 0.060 m) and a tilt (a_x, a_y); the cups' play: (c_x, c_y, 0); the zero residual: each hand's twist error (J(q_t) - J(q_F)) delta at its tool point; the mounting: the right hand's displacement rotated, w_m x (t - p_F) (its translation cancels); the fit note: nothing
route.not_the_route: the joint-space reading (the read angles plus the plan's joint displacement, as the mutant M-geom-d is built) is recorded for information under 'information_joint_space_reading': on it the fit note does reach the scored point

how_each_quantity_takes_a_static_offset.e_z: at a hold: the vertical part of the reference point's offset at that target (the reference point = the midpoint of the two grip points)
how_each_quantity_takes_a_static_offset.e_xy: at a hold: the horizontal part of the same offset
how_each_quantity_takes_a_static_offset.theta: at a hold: the deck's tilt at that target: tilt_x = (z_left - z_right) / 0.360 m of the grip points, tilt_y = the mean of the two grip frames' rotations about the handle line (world y), theta = sqrt(tilt_x^2 + tilt_y^2) (the committed step floor's definition)
how_each_quantity_takes_a_static_offset.d_m: of a move: the root mean square, over its 1160 samples (1 ms steps, the record of step j at (j + 1) ms, path length by the trapezoid of equal thirds over 1.16 s, as the grader's path rows), of the distance between the offset path and zero, the offset at each sample given by the first-order map of section 3 evaluated at that sample's planned joint angles (IK at knots every 10 mm or less, a cubic spline in the path parameter, the swivel linear from the start's to the end's); the first move starts at the grader's L, the reference point of a tray seated at F's true pose (no cups' play) + 10 mm, so its reference carries (1 - s) times the part of the seated tray's offset due to F's survey. The linear interpolation of the two ends' offsets is NOT used: it differs by up to 0.357 mm
how_each_quantity_takes_a_static_offset.rho: takes none: a difference of two settled poses of one target, in which a static offset cancels

targets.set: the 6 x 5 x 3 grid of the box (x 0.20 to 0.40 m, y -0.08 to 0.08 m, z 0.36 to 0.42 m) and the three fixed targets (0.22, 0, 0.38), (0.36, 0, 0.40), (0.40, 0, 0.36): the committed floors' set
targets.swivels: each target at the swivel the job generator stores (ref/shift.solve_target): {"45.0": 87, "54.0": 6}

moves.set: the lap's list on the nominal model (ref/shift.lap_targets): the move from L to the fixed first target and the moves between the lap's targets, one per target as the grader counts them
moves.swivels: each move ending at its target's solve_target swivel (the generator's planned lap, minimal.plan_moves, ends 3 of the 140 at another swivel, 60, 60 and 54 deg; second order)

computation.model: the maker's nominal model as vendored by the shared unit (ref/shift.Kin: base.unit_model with the file's base poses and stops)

e_z.derivation: the 90th percentile (nearest rank) of the vertical offset of the tray reference point over 93 targets x 10,000 draws of F's survey (+-0.3 mm, +-0.05 deg), the zero residual (+-0.4 deg, 14 joints) and the mounting (+-0.5 mm, +-0.15 deg) in one draw, targets commanded as displacements from the angles read at the end of the seating, F at its drawn pose, nominal model: 0.7344 mm (F's survey alone 0.270, the residual and the mounting alone 0.686)

theta.derivation: the 90th percentile of the deck's tilt (the grip points' vertical difference over 0.360 m and the grip frames' mean rotation about the handle line, root-sum-square) over the same targets and draws, the same tolerances: 0.2397 deg (F's survey alone 0.0557, the residual and the mounting alone 0.2328)

e_xy.derivation: the 90th percentile of the horizontal offset over the same targets and draws, F's survey and the cups' play (+-0.5 mm per horizontal axis) only (the residual and the mounting are this quantity's owner): 0.6983 mm (F's survey alone 0.342: the committed 0.33 with F's rotation about its frame at the 0.060 m lever)

d_m.derivation: the 90th percentile over the lap's 140 moves x 10,000 draws of the RMS over each move's 1160 samples of the offset path (the linear map at each sample's planned joint angles), every tolerance above: 1.3396 mm (F's survey alone 0.398)

rho.why: a difference: no static offset reaches it

v_c.why: the working floor: no printed tolerance gives a speed

P_r.why: the working floor: no printed tolerance gives a force

fit_note.derivation: first order: the seat is the hand's pose on its neck and lies inside the angles read at the end of the seating; a pure translation D of the hand carries the neck with it exactly, grip = (D hand) o seat^-1 = D (hand o seat^-1), so the seat adds nothing to any of the four quantities
fit_note.check: exact route, 200 draws (seed 20261123) of every tolerance, 93 targets and 28 move midpoints, the same draws with and without a seat per hand drawn as the fit note prints it (along the closing axis +-1.0 mm, the two tilts +-0.5 deg; along the faces and about the closing axis anywhere inside the capture box, +-8 mm and +-4 deg): the largest change 0.152 mm and 0.031 deg (a cross term with the residual, second order; 0 to the inverse kinematics' tolerance without the residual and the mounting); the 90th percentiles with every tolerance on: e_z 0.7274 / 0.7265 mm, theta 0.2536 / 0.2539 deg (without / with the seats)
fit_note.recorded: contributes nothing (0) to e_z, theta, e_xy and d_m on this route

checks.linear_map_vs_exact_route: 200 draws (seed 20261123) x (93 targets + 28 move midpoints): largest difference 0.049 mm in position, 0.0139 deg in tilt; the 90th percentiles with every tolerance on, exact / linear: e_z 0.7274 / 0.7285 mm, theta 0.2536 / 0.2532 deg
checks.fit_note_without_the_residual_and_the_mo: 20 of the same draws with the residual and the mounting set to 0: the largest change 6.0e-07 mm and 1.5e-07 deg (the inverse kinematics' tolerance)

the_four_T: The four T are the values of the first-order map of section 3; an independent recomputation by the exact route gave them within 1.5 %.

rows.explanation: Above 5 %: a different route, not an error in this one: the reader's code reads the joint-space route with the seated joint angles taken as the IK of the mounted model onto the drawn grip frames at swivel 45 deg, the same for every residual, and commands them plus the nominal joint displacement, so the residual it draws cancels exactly ("+ delta cancels in the difference", its own comment) and its figures are the mounting alone on a joint-space displacement (F at its drawing, the 90 grid targets at swivel 45 deg, numpy's interpolated percentile) (here, on that reading, the mounting alone gives e_z 0.169 mm: information section). On this amendment's route the residual enters fully: the controller believes the hand at FK_nom(read angles) and displaces that belief through the nominal IK, so each hand ends off by (J(q_t) - J(q_F)) delta, first order in the residual times the change of configuration from the seat to the target (components: residual_alone, mounting_alone). Even on the joint-space reading a seating that follows the servo's compliance leaves the residual's null-space part in the arm: the residual alone gives e_z 0.277 mm there (information section). Earlier independent figures for this route (0.4 deg, with the datum: horizontal p50 0.57 / p90 1.08 mm, height p90 0.72 mm, 27 targets, 500 units) agree with this amendment's (0.544 / 1.040, 0.686) within 5 %.
Above 5 %: the same cause (the residual; see residual_and_mounting_alone.e_z_p90_mm).
